stem: My classmates and I ____ excited about the upcoming field trip.
explain_zh: My classmates and I 是複數主詞，be動詞現在式要用 are；is/am 用於單數，was 是過去式。

stem: This shop ____ handmade jewelry from local designers.
explain_zh: 主詞 this shop 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，sells 正確；sell 漏 s，selling 缺助動詞，sold 是過去式。

stem: The firefighters ____ everyone out of the burning building safely.
explain_zh: 句子敘述已經發生的事件，動詞要用過去式 got；get/gets 是現在式，getting 缺助動詞。

stem: Look outside! The clouds ____ darker, so a storm might be coming.
explain_zh: Look outside 提示現在正在發生的變化，要用 be + Ving，are getting 正確；get/gets 是簡單式，got 是過去式。

stem: Scientists believe robots ____ do many jobs for humans in the future.
explain_zh: in the future 明確提示未來，要用 will + 原形動詞；did 是過去式，are/does 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: The prize will be shared between my teammate and ____.
explain_zh: between 後面要接受格，me 正確；I 是主格，my 是所有格，mine 是所有格代名詞，都不合。

stem: This is ____ unusual plant; I have never seen one like it.
explain_zh: unusual 是母音開頭發音，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭名詞，the 表特定對象，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: The zoo added several new ____ to the African exhibit this year.
explain_zh: species 是特殊名詞，單複數同形，直接用 species；specieses/speciess 拼法錯誤，species's 是所有格。

stem: The volunteers arrived ____ the shelter early to help the animals.
explain_zh: 表示抵達某個明確地點要用 at；in 用於較大範圍，on 用於平面，of 不表示位置。

stem: ____ should we go for the class trip, the beach or the mountains?
explain_zh: 詢問地點要用 Where；Who 問人，When 問時間，Why 問原因，都不合句意。

stem: Visitors ____ touch the artwork in the museum; it's fragile.
explain_zh: 表示明確禁止要用 mustn't；should 是建議語氣較弱，can 表示能力，might 表示可能性，都不合此禁止規定。

stem: There ____ a strange noise coming from the old clock every hour.
explain_zh: noise 是不可數名詞，視為單數，there be 現在式要用 is；are/were 用於複數或過去式，be 是原形。

stem: This route is ____ than the one we took last time.
explain_zh: 比較兩者要用比較級 shorter；short 是原級，shortest 是最高級，more short 是錯誤形式（short 為單音節）。

stem: ____ leave your valuables unattended at the train station.
explain_zh: 祈使句表示強烈禁止可用 Never，語意等同「絕對不要」；Always/Sometimes/Often 都不能表達禁止的語氣。

stem: One of the biggest problems in our city ____ traffic congestion.
explain_zh: one of... 當主詞視為單數，be動詞要用 is；are/were 用於複數，am 只能搭配 I。

stem: This app ____ students track their homework and deadlines.
explain_zh: 主詞 this app 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，helps 正確；help 漏 s，helped 是過去式，helping 缺助動詞。

stem: The volunteers ____ hundreds of trees along the riverbank last spring.
explain_zh: last spring 提示過去式，動詞要用過去式 planted；plant/plants 是現在式，planting 缺助動詞。

stem: These days, more and more people ____ electric scooters to save energy.
explain_zh: These days 表示近期正在發生的趨勢，要用 be + Ving，are using 正確；use/uses 是簡單式，used 是過去式。

stem: If it rains tomorrow, the outdoor concert ____ be canceled.
explain_zh: 未來條件句主要子句要用 will + 原形動詞；did/was 是過去式，is 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: The manager thanked the whole team, including ____, for the hard work.
explain_zh: including 後面要接受格，us 正確；we 是主格，our 是所有格形容詞，ours 是所有格代名詞，都不合。

stem: My teacher is ____ excellent guide who explains things clearly.
explain_zh: excellent 是母音開頭發音，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭名詞，the 表特定，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: We spotted a group of wild ____ near the campsite at dawn.
explain_zh: deer 是特殊複數，單複數同形，直接用 deer；deers/deeres 拼法錯誤，deer's 是所有格。

stem: The novel is based ____ a true story from World War II.
explain_zh: be based on 表示「根據、基於」是固定片語；in/at/of 都不能與 based 搭配成這個意思。

stem: ____ did you find out about the change in the exam schedule?
explain_zh: 詢問方法或途徑要用 How；Who 問人，What 問事物，Why 問原因，都不合句意。

stem: Passengers ____ fasten their seatbelts before the plane takes off.
explain_zh: 表示強制規定要用 must；can 表示能力，might/would 語氣不夠肯定，都不合此規定情境。

stem: ____ there any tickets left for tonight's basketball game?
explain_zh: tickets 是複數名詞，there be 疑問句要用 Are；Is 用於單數，Was 是過去式，Does 不是 be動詞。

stem: Of all the apps on my phone, this game is ____ addictive.
explain_zh: of all 提示三者以上的最高級，要用 the most；more 是比較級用法，most 少了 the，much 不是最高級形式。

stem: ____ about joining the debate club this semester?
explain_zh: How about + Ving 表示提議「要不要…」；What/Why/When 都不能構成這個固定提議句型。

stem: The biggest challenge for new students ____ making friends quickly.
explain_zh: the biggest challenge 是單數主詞，be動詞現在式要用 is；are/were 用於複數，am 只能搭配 I。

stem: This recipe ____ only five simple ingredients and ten minutes.
explain_zh: 主詞 this recipe 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，requires 正確；require 漏 s，requiring 缺助動詞，required 是過去式。

stem: The explorers ____ across the desert without any modern equipment.
explain_zh: 句子描述過去發生的探險過程，動詞要用過去式 traveled；travel/travels 是現在式，traveling 缺助動詞。

stem: Right now, the whole class ____ a presentation about ocean pollution.
explain_zh: Right now 表示現在進行，要用 be + Ving，is preparing 正確；prepare/prepares 是簡單式，prepared 是過去式。

stem: Many experts predict the sea level ____ rise significantly by 2100.
explain_zh: by 2100 明確提示未來，要用 will + 原形動詞；did/was 是過去式，is 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: The award went to the coach and ____ for their years of effort.
explain_zh: went to 後面要接受格，him 正確；he 是主格，his 是所有格，he's 是 he is 的縮寫，都不合文法。

stem: She lives in ____ old house that was built over a century ago.
explain_zh: old 是母音開頭發音，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭，the 表特定對象，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: The dentist examined all of my ____ during the checkup yesterday.
explain_zh: tooth 的複數是不規則變化 teeth，要直接用；tooths/teeths 拼法錯誤，tooth 是單數。

stem: The article was written ____ a famous journalist from Taipei.
explain_zh: 表示動作的執行者要用 by，written by 表示「由...所寫」；with/for/of 都不能表示這個被動行為者。

stem: ____ often do you update your social media profile?
explain_zh: How often 詢問「頻率」；What/Why/Which 都不能與 often 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: You ____ worry so much; the interview will probably go well.
explain_zh: 表示委婉勸阻不必做要用 shouldn't；can 表示能力，must/have to 表示義務，語意都不合此安慰情境。

stem: There ____ many opportunities to volunteer abroad these days.
explain_zh: opportunities 是複數名詞，there be 現在式要用 are；is 用於單數，was 是過去式，be 是原形。

stem: This model of laptop is ____ than the previous version.
explain_zh: 比較兩者要用比較級 lighter；light 是原級，lightest 是最高級，more light 是錯誤形式（light 為單音節）。

stem: ____ we ask the librarian for help finding this book?
explain_zh: Shall we...? 是提議「我們要不要…」的固定句型；Do/Will/Are 不能這樣直接用於此種提議句型。

stem: Several of the exhibits ____ closed for repairs this week.
explain_zh: several of 後面的主詞視為複數，be動詞要用 are；is/was 用於單數，am 只能搭配 I。

stem: The committee ____ new proposals at the end of every meeting.
explain_zh: 主詞 the committee 視為單數，現在式動詞要加 s，reviews 正確；review 漏 s，reviewed 是過去式，reviewing 缺助動詞。

stem: The engineers ____ a new bridge design last month for the city council.
explain_zh: last month 提示過去式，動詞要用過去式 proposed；propose/proposes 是現在式，proposing 缺助動詞。

stem: At this very moment, researchers ____ a cure for the rare disease.
explain_zh: At this very moment 表示現在進行，要用 be + Ving，are developing 正確；develop/develops 是簡單式，developed 是過去式。

stem: Unless we hurry, we ____ miss the last train home.
explain_zh: unless 引導的條件句，主要子句要用 will + 原形動詞；did/was 是過去式，are 不能直接接原形動詞表未來。

stem: The prize money will be divided equally between you and ____.
explain_zh: between 後面要接受格，me 正確；I 是主格，my 是所有格，mine 是所有格代名詞，都不合。

stem: My cousin just became ____ honorable member of the student council.
explain_zh: honorable 開頭的 h 不發音，等於母音開頭，要用 an；a 用於子音開頭發音的字，the 表特定，some 不能接單數可數名詞。

stem: The biologist studies how different ____ of fish adapt to warm water.
explain_zh: species 是特殊名詞，單複數同形，直接用 species；specieses/speciess 拼法錯誤，species's 是所有格。

stem: The charity event raised money ____ children in need.
explain_zh: 表示「為了某人的利益」要用 for；by 表示執行者，with 表示伴隨，of 不表示這個目的。

stem: ____ subjects are you taking this semester, five or six?
explain_zh: subjects 是可數複數名詞，詢問數量要用 How many；How much 用於不可數名詞，How long 問長度，How often 問頻率。

stem: You ____ submit the application before the deadline, or it won't be accepted.
explain_zh: 表示必要且強制的規定要用 must；can 表示能力，might/would 語氣不夠肯定，都不合此規定情境。

stem: ____ there a shortcut to the community center from here?
explain_zh: a shortcut 是單數名詞，there be 疑問句要用 Is；Are 用於複數，Were 是過去式，Do 不是 be動詞。

stem: This is ____ dangerous trail in the entire national park.
explain_zh: in the entire national park 提示三者以上的最高級，dangerous 是多音節形容詞要用 the most dangerous；more 是比較級用法，most 少了 the，much more 語法錯誤。

stem: ____ leave your bike unlocked outside the station overnight.
explain_zh: 祈使句表示強烈禁止可用 Never，語意等同「絕對不要」；Always/Sometimes/Usually 都不能表達禁止的語氣。

stem: The most important thing in a friendship ____ trust and honesty.
explain_zh: 主詞 the most important thing 是單數，be動詞現在式要用 is；are/were 用於複數，am 只能搭配 I。

stem: This machine ____ plastic bottles into small pieces for recycling.
explain_zh: 主詞 this machine 是第三人稱單數，現在式動詞要加 s，shreds 正確；shred 漏 s，shredded 是過去式，shredding 缺助動詞。

stem: The team ____ a strategy meeting before the big competition last week.
explain_zh: last week 提示過去式，hold 的過去式是 held；hold/holds 是現在式，holding 缺助動詞。

stem: Currently, the government ____ a new policy to reduce plastic waste.
explain_zh: Currently 表示現在進行，要用 be + Ving，is testing 正確；test/tests 是簡單式，tested 是過去式。

stem: I usually ____ the trash cans out to the curb on Tuesday nights.
explain_zh: take the trash out 表示「把垃圾拿出去」是固定片語；make/do/give 都不能與 trash out 搭配成這個意思。

stem: Please ____ your name at the top of the answer sheet.
explain_zh: 在作答紙上「寫下」姓名要用 write；draw 是畫圖，paint 是上色，carve 是雕刻，都不是填寫姓名的正確動作。

stem: My father's younger brother is my ____, and he is very funny.
explain_zh: father's younger brother（父親的弟弟）稱為 uncle（叔叔）；nephew 是姪子，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，grandfather 是祖父，都不合。

stem: This curry is way too ____ for me; I need some water immediately.
explain_zh: 需要立刻喝水通常是因為食物 spicy（辣的）；sweet/fresh/sour 都不會讓人急著喝水。

stem: The meeting has been moved ____ Thursday instead of Wednesday.
explain_zh: move something to + 時間 表示「改到...」；at/in/on 都不能與 moved 搭配表達改期到某天。

stem: The forecast says it will be ____ tomorrow, so bring a jacket.
explain_zh: 需要帶外套通常是因為天氣 chilly（涼冷的）；humid 是潮濕的，sunny 是晴朗的，dry 是乾燥的，都不太需要帶外套保暖。

stem: You can get your passport photo taken at the ____ near the station.
explain_zh: 拍護照照片要去 photo studio（照相館）；bakery 是麵包店，clinic 是診所，bookstore 是書店，都不能拍證件照。

stem: My little sister loves ____ paper cranes in her free time.
explain_zh: fold paper cranes（摺紙鶴）是常見的手作嗜好；cook/paint/cut 都不能與 paper cranes 搭配成合理動作。

stem: He felt ____ when everyone laughed at his mistake in front of the class.
explain_zh: 全班嘲笑他的錯誤通常會感到 embarrassed（尷尬的）；delighted 是高興的，calm 是冷靜的，confident 是有信心的，語意都不合此情境。

stem: She had trouble hearing the announcement well because of an ____.
explain_zh: 聽不清楚廣播通常與耳朵有關，earache 表示「耳朵痛」；headache 是頭痛，stomachache 是胃痛，toothache 是牙痛，都與聽力障礙較無直接關聯。

stem: The old coin is worth a lot of money because it is very ____.
explain_zh: 值錢通常是因為物品 rare（稀有的）；cheap 是便宜的，common 是常見的，light 是輕的，都與「值很多錢」矛盾。

stem: I want to ____ this sweater for a different color, please.
explain_zh: 換成不同顏色要用 exchange（交換）；return 是退回，refund 是退款，cancel 是取消，語意都不如 exchange 精確。

stem: I like to ____ the table before my family sits down for dinner.
explain_zh: set the table 表示「擺放餐具」是固定片語；cook/wash/cut 都不能與 table 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: Our teacher will ____ the results of the science fair tomorrow.
explain_zh: announce the results 表示「宣布結果」；borrow 是借用，forget 是忘記，ignore 是忽略，語意都不合公布結果的情境。

stem: My father's new wife is my ____, and she is friendly to everyone.
explain_zh: father's new wife（父親再婚的妻子）稱為 stepmother（繼母）；aunt 是姑姑/阿姨，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，grandmother 是祖母，都不合。

stem: This bread is several days old and tastes quite ____ now.
explain_zh: 放了好幾天的麵包通常變得 stale（不新鮮的）；fresh/warm/soft 都與「放了好幾天」矛盾。

stem: We need to finish this project ____ the end of this week.
explain_zh: 表示「在...之前完成」的截止時間要用 by；at/on/in 都不能表達這個「不晚於」的意思。

stem: It's too ____ to go hiking today; the trail will be dangerous.
explain_zh: 步道會有危險通常是因為天氣 stormy（暴風雨的）；sunny/clear/mild 都不會讓步道變危險。

stem: You can get your shoes repaired at the small ____ near the market.
explain_zh: 修鞋的地方是 cobbler's（修鞋店）；bakery 是麵包店，pharmacy 是藥局，florist's 是花店，都不能修鞋。

stem: On weekends, my father enjoys ____ old radios in his workshop.
explain_zh: fix old radios（修理舊收音機）是常見的嗜好；cook/sell/wash radios 都不是合理的興趣描述。

stem: The little boy felt ____ when he saw the huge roller coaster.
explain_zh: 看到巨大的雲霄飛車通常感到 scared（害怕的）；bored 是無聊的，proud 是驕傲的，calm 是冷靜的，語意都不合此情境。

stem: He couldn't walk properly after he badly sprained his ____.
explain_zh: 影響走路的關節是 knee（膝蓋）；wrist/elbow/shoulder 都是上肢關節，不會直接影響走路。

stem: The store gives a ____ to students who show their student ID.
explain_zh: 憑學生證享有優惠要用 discount（折扣）；profit 是利潤，tax 是稅金，interest 是利息，都不是購物優惠的正確說法。

stem: This coat is made of real wool, so the ____ feels very soft.
explain_zh: 描述材質觸感要用 fabric（布料）；brand 是品牌，label 是標籤，price 是價格，都與觸感無關。

stem: Every night before bed, I ____ my teeth for two full minutes.
explain_zh: brush one's teeth 表示「刷牙」是固定片語；cook/wash/comb 都不能與 teeth 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: The principal will ____ the top three students during the assembly.
explain_zh: 表揚優秀學生要用 reward（獎勵）；punish 是懲罰，ignore 是忽略，blame 是責怪，語意都相反或不合。

stem: My grandmother's youngest daughter is my ____, and she lives abroad.
explain_zh: grandmother's daughter（祖母的女兒，且不是自己的母親）稱為 aunt（姑姑/阿姨）；niece 是姪女，cousin 是表堂兄弟姊妹，grandmother 是祖母本人，都不合。

stem: This steak is cooked perfectly; it's juicy and very ____.
explain_zh: 完美烹調的牛排通常多汁且 tender（軟嫩的）；tough 是難嚼的，dry 是乾的，raw 是生的，都與「完美烹調」矛盾。

stem: The store stays open ____ midnight during the holiday season.
explain_zh: 表示「持續到...為止」要用 until；since 表示「自從」，during 表示「在...期間」，by 表示「不晚於」，語意都不合。

stem: Everything looked blurry because of the thick ____ this morning.
explain_zh: 看起來模糊通常是因為濃 fog（霧）；rain/snow/wind 通常不會讓視線模糊到「blurry」的程度。

stem: We picked up our new glasses at the ____ downtown yesterday.
explain_zh: 配眼鏡的地方是 optician's（眼鏡行）；bakery 是麵包店，laundry 是洗衣店，butcher's 是肉舖，都不能配眼鏡。

stem: My grandfather still enjoys ____ old stamps he collected decades ago.
explain_zh: display old stamps（展示舊郵票）符合收藏嗜好的常見描述；cook/sell/wash stamps 都不是合理的動作。

stem: I felt completely ____ after solving the puzzle that took three hours.
explain_zh: 花三小時終於解出謎題通常感到 satisfied（滿足的）；annoyed 是惱怒的，ashamed 是羞愧的，anxious 是焦慮的，語意都不合完成任務的情境。

stem: After the long hike, both of my ____ felt sore and weak.
explain_zh: 長途健行後最容易痠痛無力的部位是 legs（腿）；ears/hands/eyes 都不是健行後典型痠痛的部位。

stem: The company offered him a much higher ____ for the new position.
explain_zh: 公司提供的職位待遇要用 salary（薪水）；bill 是帳單，tax 是稅金，fee 是費用，都不是「職位待遇」的正確說法。

stem: I bought this dress online, but the ____ doesn't match the photo.
explain_zh: 與照片不符通常是在描述顏色，color 正確；price/brand/size 都不是「與照片不符」最直接對應的外觀描述。

stem: I always ____ my phone before I go to sleep at night.
explain_zh: charge one's phone 表示「幫手機充電」；cook/wash/cut 都不能與 phone 搭配表示這個意思。

stem: The coach will ____ the team for the district competition next week.
explain_zh: train the team 表示「訓練隊伍」；punish 是懲罰，forget 是忘記，blame 是責怪，語意都不合準備比賽的情境。

stem: My uncle's daughter is my ____, and we often play together.
explain_zh: uncle's daughter（叔叔的女兒）稱為 cousin（表姊妹）；niece 是姪女，sister 是姊妹，aunt 是姑姑，都不合。

stem: The chef added extra herbs to make the dish more ____.
explain_zh: 加入額外香草通常是為了讓菜餚更 aromatic（香氣濃郁的）；bland/plain/dull 都與「額外添加香草」的目的矛盾。
